# Challenge 4: make the coins negative

The counter starts at zero and only grows. Make it go negative in the app's
UI, without patching the dex.

**Hints**:

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

`GameState.coins` is a public static int, written by `addCoins`.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

You can write the field directly, or change what `addCoins` does.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 3</summary>

The hook `watch_coins.js` shows the read-modify-write in action. You are
allowed to modify what it observes.
</details>

[Counting coins](../android_journey/counting_coins.qmd) covers the field and
the Java hook. The dummy `Memory.alloc` cell in that chapter is not
`GameState.coins`.
